current_activity: division command post at Pont-à-Mousson after landing in France
notes: Event date: 14 January 1945 (CMH ETO-OB lists the 8th Armored Division command post at Pont-à-Mousson, Meurthe-et-Moselle, on 14 January; the same page gives arrival on the Continent on 6 January 1945 and first elements in combat on 19 January 1945). Event definition: a CMH list places the division headquarters at Pont-à-Mousson; the division is first in the dataset here, assigned to Fifteenth Army and attached to Third Army in the CMH table. Relationship: Third Army attached (from 12 Jan 45 to 31 Jan 45, CMH table); Fifteenth Army assigned (from 8 Jan 45 to 22 Jan 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 2 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). Location: Pont-à-Mousson (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R516 p. 495: listed 14 January 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Pont-à-Mousson. Event support: moderate (one official table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).

current_activity: attached to the previously uncommitted XVI Corps to hold the Ninth Army's new sector to Roermond
notes: Event date: 6 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 8 p. 136: the Ninth Army on 6 February assumed responsibility for eighteen miles of the British line as far as Roermond; to occupy the new sector General Simpson attached the 8th Armored and 35th Divisions to the previously uncommitted XVI Corps; the passage gives no separate day for the attachment). Event definition: the division comes under the XVI Corps (Anderson) in the Ninth Army sector; the CMH table lists XVI Corps and Ninth Army from 1 February, five days before the Green Book date. Relationship: XVI Corps unspecified_subordination (from 1 Feb 45 to 31 Mar 45, CMH table); Ninth Army assigned (from 1 Feb 45, CMH table); 21st Army Group attached (from 1 Feb 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 2 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Simpelveld (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R516 p. 495: listed 4 February 1945; 2 days before the row); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Simpelveld. Event support: moderate (Green Book gives the sector takeover on 6 February; the CMH table dates the assignment to 1 February). Location support: moderate (nearest earlier command post, 2 days before the row; the position on the date is not documented).
